# Nectarine Studio

> Nectarine Studio is a remote brand strategy and design studio for climate tech, environmental, and impact-focused companies. We help founders and communications leaders turn complex, technical, or mission-driven work into a clear brand story — through brand narrative, messaging, copywriting, visual identity, pitch decks, and websites. Founded in 2024. Contact: hello@nectarine.ink

## Who we work with

- Early-stage climate and environmental tech founders (Seed to Series A) whose technology is strong but whose pitch and positioning are too dense to land with investors or early customers.
- In-house brand and communications leaders at sustainability-focused companies and ESG platforms who need a senior creative partner for a refresh, a new market, or a major launch.
- Founders and communications leaders at economic development, workforce, and job-creation ventures who have outgrown their early-stage story and need positioning that earns institutional credibility.
- Impact investors, accelerators, CDFIs, and sustainability/ESG consultants looking for a trusted brand partner for their portfolio companies and clients.

## What we do

- Brand strategy: brand narrative and alignment workshops, narrative audits, visual identity audits, and positioning.
- Writing and copy: brand messaging frameworks, website copy, campaign copy, long-form content, and scripts.
- Design: visual identity development, brand guides, print, publication, and event design.
- Digital and UI design: website design (homepage and internal pages), landing pages, and email design.
- Pitch decks and presentations: slide design and investor narratives.
- Ongoing retainer engagements.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.nectarine.ink/): Overview of the studio, featured work, services, and how to get in touch.
- [Our Work](https://www.nectarine.ink/work): Portfolio of brand, web, and campaign projects.
- [Creative Services](https://www.nectarine.ink/what-we-do): The full list of services — design, writing and copy, digital and UI design, video and media, event design, and workshops and audits.
- [About](https://www.nectarine.ink/about): The people behind Nectarine Studio, plus the mission, vision, and values that shape how we work.
- [Free Brand Alignment Audit](https://www.nectarine.ink/audit): An interactive tool that gives a quick read on a brand's and website's strengths and gaps.
- [Contact](https://www.nectarine.ink/contact): Contact form and booking link for a strategy call.

## Case studies

- [Frontier Operators](https://www.nectarine.ink/portfolio/frontier-operators): Strategy and messaging for a venture deploying trained operators to scale businesses in frontier markets.
- [Faithful Talent](https://www.nectarine.ink/portfolio/faithful-talent): Brand strategy, naming, copywriting, and identity for a values-driven professional network.
- [Pinkston for Tennessee](https://www.nectarine.ink/portfolio/pinkston-for-tn): Brand identity, web presence, and campaign materials for an independent run for Governor of Tennessee.
- [David Bruce Winery](https://www.nectarine.ink/portfolio/david-bruce-winery): Bottle and crate design for the 50th anniversary of the Judgment of Paris.
- [He Who Speaks Out of Turn](https://www.nectarine.ink/portfolio/michael-cook): Art direction, illustration, and cartography for Michael Cook's debut novel.
